summary_1line: Amid brutal mass combat, Bhima and others confront Drona’s forces as Arjuna returns, slays Karna’s brothers, and clashes with Karna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna’s chariot bearing the ape-banner blazes across a battlefield of blood-filled ruts as fallen elephants and warriors lie scattered beneath arrow storms.
Bhima leaps from his chariot like Garuda, sword raised, cutting through the warriors protecting Karna amid shattered chariots and fleeing horses.
Two massive elephants collide and collapse among crushed soldiers while arrows protrude from their trunks in the dust-choked chaos of battle.
